name: Maprisma
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI agents, local LLMs, models, MCP servers and skills on one map: draw a line to connect them, with a short check first and Undo after. Ask AI suggests questions and can make the same changes for you. Nothing to set up by hand: a click on the bar icon offers to install the Maprisma app; after you confirm, it installs it for your user (download from GitHub, SHA-256 checked, no password) and opens it.
